author: Phobiaxx
body:
So, I made a previous batch of suggestions, but a lot of them were unnecessary, and I've got a few more Ideas/tweaks. Original:http://avicus.net/forums/d96306342?page=1

I've decided to make a series of sugs, Staff, Player, and Site. (player and site are still being worked on)
Purpose:To make everyone's life easier, especially moderators.

Suggestions:

InfractionLink[All staff!]-a plugin that allows staff members to check player's infractions. Can be activated by either /il <player> or /<infractioncmd> <playername>(when a moderator is punishing a player, and presses TAB after the name, it will show the players infractions.) This mode can be toggled with /il on, /il off.
It'll show like:
Player RandomNoob:
[3 days ago]Excessive Swearing{AwsmMod}<Tempban-1:00>
[2 days ago]Excessive Hackusations{AwsmMod1}<Tempban-1:00>
[24 hours ago]Excessive Nubness{awsmmod2}<Tempban-3:00>
[12 hours ago]Swearing.{awsmmod3}<Kick>
/tempban RandomNoob 2d Excessive Infractions.
Or in detail:


NCPFeed/CheatFeed[Mods+]-Configure NCP/AntiCheat so moderators can view, instead of just OPs. Configure it so the infractions are translated, from things like: fight.directional into "aimbot/killaura" The rest should be already part of NCP. Of course, NCP won't be enough, the moderators still have to spectate, but now they can tell which reports actually have the possibility of being true.

Msg[All Staff]:Mods have permission to /msg all players, even if they are not friended, or on the same mini-server. (I'm guessing this doesn't exist yet, since staff had to /bukkit:tell to speak.


Vanish[Mods+]/v to toggle, staff are invisible to everyone except for other staff. Can only work in spectator mode. Can work for Sr.Mods+ in Creative Mode.

<Later>
After 1.8 is installed, allow moderators+ to use spectator mode.

What do you think of these 3 sugs? ;p

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
On the Overcast Network there is an /l (slash, lower case L) command that allows you to view the punishment history of any player.

For example: /l SnowSX3

It will come up with the punishment, the date of that punishment and the mod who issued the punishment.

Only problem is that it's available for anyone to use, I suggest if we had something like this on Avicus, then it should only be for moderator use.

This may be quite handy for the Avicus staff.
Thoughts?
